question.subject: algebra
question.text: If a⁴ + b⁴ + a²b² = 8 and a² + b² + ab = 4, then the value of ab is:

lessons.title: Trick 1: Identity (10 seconds)
lessons.works_when: The question has a⁴ + a²b² + b⁴ and a² + ab + b².

steps.say: Dekho, pehli equation mein a to the power 4, a square b square, b to the power 4 hai, aur doosri mein a square, a b, b square. Yeh pattern pehchano!
Yeh famous identity hai: a to the power 4 plus a square b square plus b to the power 4 barabar a square plus a b plus b square, into a square minus a b plus b square.
Ab 8 ko likho, 4 into bracket. Kyunki a square plus a b plus b square ka value 4 hai.
Dono side 4 se divide karo. Mila a square plus b square minus a b barabar 2.
Ab dono equations ko subtract karo. a square aur b square cut ho gaye, bacha 2 a b barabar 2. To a b barabar 1.

lessons.title: Trick 2: Substitution
lessons.works_when: You know a²+b²+ab and can rewrite a⁴+b⁴ using x = a²+b² and y = ab.

steps.say: Agar identity yaad nahi hai to substitution lagao. a square plus b square ko x maano, aur a b ko y.
a to the power 4 plus b to the power 4 ko x square minus 2 y square likhte hain.
Pehli equation mein daalo: x square minus 2 y square plus y square, barabar 8. Yaani x square minus y square barabar 8.
x square minus y square ko (x minus y)(x plus y) likho. x plus y chaar hai, to x minus y barabar 2.
x plus y chaar aur x minus y do ko jodo. 2x barabar 6, x barabar 3. Isliye y, yaani a b, barabar 1.

lessons.title: Trick 3: Option elimination
lessons.works_when: Options are small numbers that are quick to test.

steps.say: Options mein 0, 2 aur 1 hai. Sabse pehle 0 test karte hain.
Agar a b zero hota, to a square plus b square barabar 4 hota. Tab a to the power 4 plus b to the power 4 barabar 16 hota, 8 nahi. Option b out.
Ab a b barabar 2 lo. Tab a square plus b square barabar 2 aata hai, lekin a square plus b square kabhi 2 a b, yaani 4 se chhota nahi ho sakta. Option c out.
Ab a b barabar 1: a square plus b square barabar 3, a to the power 4 plus b to the power 4 barabar 9 minus 2, yaani 7. 7 plus 1 barabar 8. Sahi! Option d.
